rationale:
The defect is a boolean precedence bug in DartEmitter's FunctionType visitor: the guard for emitting the parameter separator was `optionalParameters.isNotEmpty || (namedParameters.isNotEmpty && requiredParameters.isNotEmpty)`, so a FunctionType with optional positional parameters but no required parameters emitted a leading redundant comma (e.g. `String Function(, [int])`). The fix in patches/production-fix.patch restructures the condition to `requiredParameters.isNotEmpty && (optionalParameters.isNotEmpty || namedParameters.isNotEmpty)`, which is the minimal correction to that same expression and matches the upstream subject 'fix redundant , in Function type'. The minimized production patch is byte-identical to the production fix and touches only lib/src/emitter.dart with no formatting, refactor, config, or doc changes; the test hunk is isolated in patches/trigger-tests.patch. The trigger tests are the unchanged upstream tests from the same commit and exercise only pre-existing public API (FunctionType, refer, requiredParameters/optionalParameters/namedParameters, equalsDart) — the fix introduces no new API, so no dependency on post-fix surface. Strict evidence (strict_original and strict_post_minimization, both passed with zero failed checks) confirms build on both revisions, a deterministic buggy differential reproduced on 'should create a function type with an optional positional parameter', all-green fixed runs, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so the root cause is not a duplicate, and dart-lang/code_builder#231 is the supplied verified key.

The defect is a Dart operator-precedence bug in DartEmitter's FunctionType visitor: `optionalParameters.isNotEmpty || namedParameters.isNotEmpty && requiredParameters.isNotEmpty` parses as `optional || (named && required)`, so a separator comma was emitted whenever optionalParameters was non-empty even with zero required parameters, yielding `String Function(, [int])`. The fix rewrites the guard as `required && (optional || named)`, which is the minimal semantic correction and matches the PR subject 'fix redundant , in Function type' (dart-lang/code_builder#231, the public artifact referenced by issue_urls and verified via traceability.verified_fix_issue_numbers). The minimized production patch touches only that single boolean condition in lib/src/emitter.dart: no renames, no reformatting elsewhere, no new API, no config or docs. The trigger patch is the unchanged upstream test block from the same fixing commit and exercises only pre-existing public API (FunctionType, returnType, requiredParameters, optionalParameters, namedParameters, refer, equalsDart); the fix adds no production API the tests could depend on. Strict evidence (original and post-minimization) reports all gates passing: build on both revisions, deterministic differential where 'should create a function type with an optional positional parameter' fails alone on the buggy revision and all five selectors plus the full suite are green on the fixed revision, with 3 repetitions across a complete 56-run matrix. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no active registry entry.
